test_compare_scalar_interval: test comparing an IntervalArray with a scalar Interval using equality or inequality operators
test_compare_scalar_interval_mixed_close: test comparing IntervalArrays with different closed endpoints (left, right, both, neither)
test_compare_scalar_na: test comparing IntervalArrays against pd.NA and None values for equality and inequality
test_compare_scalar_other: test comparing IntervalArrays with scalar types like int, float, bool, string, Timestamp, Timedelta, Period
test_compare_list_like_interval: test comparing IntervalArrays with list-like Interval objects including same, reversed, and NaN endpoints
test_compare_list_like_interval_mixed_cl: test comparing IntervalArrays with list-like Interval objects having mixed closed parameters
test_compare_length_mismatch_errors: test that comparing IntervalArrays of mismatched lengths raises ValueError
test_compare_list_like_boxed_lhs: test that IntervalIndex and Series delegate list-like comparisons to IntervalArray
test_comparison_operations: test comparing Interval Series with scalar values like strings, booleans, numbers, and None
